verdict.rationale: Cal.com mentions 'workflows' as a platform feature and documents recurring bookings via POST /v2/bookings. Automation is otherwise event-triggered, through booking webhooks and the Zapier app firing on booking created, rescheduled or cancelled. There is no evidence of scheduling arbitrary recurring jobs or time-based workflow runs. Missing for 10: cron-like or recurring scheduling of jobs/workflows, documentation of workflow configuration and scheduling via API, MCP or CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
